name: Yellow Wheel Ceramics
tagline: Wheel-thrown and handbuilt porcelain from a home studio in New York.
heroText: Wheel-thrown and handcrafted porcelain that balances form and function, finished with underglazes, layered glazes and transfer patterns. Each piece is one of a kind.
studioVisits: Studio visits are by appointment. Send a note and we will find a time.
shortBio: Claudia Palermo is a ceramic artist and lifelong educator based in New York. After earning degrees from Skidmore College and Teachers College, Columbia University, she spent 36 years shaping the art program at Westlake High School in Mt. Pleasant before retiring in 2024 to dedicate herself full-time to her studio practice. Working primarily in porcelain, Claudia creates wheel-thrown and handcrafted functional art characterized by intricate surface treatments, underglazes, and dynamic transfer patterns.
